name: @sepoina/vitetranslate
versionDescription: Every LLM flag now lives under one --llm-* namespace (--llm-translate, --llm-retranslate, --llm-context, --llm-status, --llm-ping, --llm-key-set/status/clear, --llm-dry-run, --llm-auto, --llm-noask); the 4.5 names are gone, no alias, an unrecognised --llm-* is an error naming the valid flags. New: llm.costGuard skips the confirmation question below an estimated cost (never the numeric caps, never the CI guard), and --llm-debug logs every request, reply and error — redacted, git-ignored — to <localeDir>/.llm/<timestamp>/ for a run you need to inspect. And every request now has its own line on a terminal, redrawn live once a second, replaced at the end by a log with what each one cost. Also fixed: a refused run (budget, CI, declined) now prints why and exits 1, instead of the 4.5.0 silence and exit 0.
description: Extract translatable strings straight from your JSX — a Vite plugin that auto-generates and syncs your translation tables, with zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.playground:previewpages: npm run build && npm --prefix playground run preview -- --base=/viteTranslate/
scripts.edge:install: npm --prefix playEdge install --no-workspaces && npm --prefix playEdge run link:lib
